kashika: आदिरुदात्त इति वर्तते। शुष्क धृष्ट इत्येतावाद्युदात्तौ भवतः। शुष्कः॑। धृष्टः॑। असंज्ञार्थ आरम्भः॥
kashikaEnglish: Accent rules for various technical formations.
englishFull:
शुष्कधृष्टौ — शुष्क and धृष्ट also have first-syllable acute.

शुष्कः, धृष्टः

These are not names (unlike the previous rule), yet take first-syllable accent.
